FQRESTRAIN.settings.distanceEnabled.name: Enable combat speed limit
FQRESTRAIN.settings.distanceEnabled.hint: When enabled, on their turn in combat a token cannot move farther than the speed of the movement mode it is using (walk, fly, burrow, climb, swim), in the scene distance units.
FQRESTRAIN.settings.turnEnabled.name: Block movement out of turn
FQRESTRAIN.settings.turnEnabled.hint: When enabled, in combat a token cannot move when it is not its turn.
FQRESTRAIN.settings.gmNotRestrained.name: GM is not restrained
FQRESTRAIN.settings.gmNotRestrained.hint: When enabled, the Game Master is exempt from all movement restrictions.
FQRESTRAIN.settings.takeBackEnabled.name: Block taking back a move
FQRESTRAIN.settings.takeBackEnabled.hint: When enabled, a token in combat cannot move back toward the position it started its turn on. No restriction outside combat.
FQRESTRAIN.settings.takeBackGraceSeconds: Seconds after a turn starts during which a move can still be taken back before the position is locked in. 0 = lock immediately.
FQRESTRAIN.settings.speedPath.name: Actor speed data path
FQRESTRAIN.settings.speedPath.hint: Only for systems the module does not detect on its own (dnd5e and pf2e are built in). Dot path to the actor data holding the speeds, e.g. "system.attributes.movement" for a per-mode object, or "system.details.move.value" for a single walk speed. Leave empty for automatic detection.
FQRESTRAIN.keybindings.bypass.name: Bypass movement restrictions
FQRESTRAIN.keybindings.bypass.hint: Hold this key to temporarily bypass all active movement restrictions.
FQRESTRAIN.notifications.distanceBlocked: Combat movement limited to your speed ({speed}).
Combat movement limited to your {action} speed ({speed}).
FQRESTRAIN.notifications.speedZero: This token has a speed of 0 and cannot move.
FQRESTRAIN.notifications.turnBlocked: You cannot move: it is not this token's turn.
FQRESTRAIN.notifications.takeBackBlocked: You cannot move back toward the position you started your turn on.
